note: Deployment environments and their approval gates. TASK-016 declares them; TASK-018's pipeline deploys through them and is what makes the gate unskippable. Reviewer teams are GitHub team slugs in the repository's organisation (.github/CODEOWNERS names the same set); 'delivery' does not exist yet.

environments.name: dev
environments.approval: Automatic on a green main build. No human gate: DEV exists to be deployed to.

environments.name: sit
environments.approval: DevOps Lead. Preconditions: quality gates green (TASK-015), artifact scan clean (TASK-022), migration dry-run succeeds.

environments.name: uat
environments.approval: QA Lead and Security Lead. Preconditions: the 15 cross-domain e2e journeys pass against SIT (TASK-085); no open High/Critical threat-model finding without a signed AHDA risk acceptance (TASK-081).

environments.name: prod
environments.approval: Delivery Lead and AHDA Sponsor, recorded with approver identity and timestamp (Release Checklist 'Production Deployment Approval Recorded'). Preconditions: UAT acceptance signed, penetration test clean (TASK-082), restore drill passed (TASK-023), rollback rehearsed within 30 days (TASK-037/CTL-37).
